privacy.notes: Metadata-only Scala/Spark binding contract. It describes request and response structs, transport fallback, diagnostics, provenance, errors, fixture gates, and module readiness without committing calculator logic or licensed payloads.

public_calculator_contract.notes: The Scala/Spark binding request and response structs mirror the public calculator contract fields and only add transport metadata for service, file-exchange, and SQL boundaries.

transport_modes.notes: Primary path for Spark DataFrame and Parquet/Arrow batch consumption in lakehouse workflows.
Primary path for Spark SQL, DuckDB, or JDBC analytical queries against pre-computed outputs.
Fallback path for callers that need online request/response behavior via HTTP/REST.

request_structs.name: ScalaSparkBindingRequest

fields.name: schema_version
fields.notes: Binding schema version for the request envelope.

fields.name: calculator_id
fields.notes: Public calculator identifier from the shared contract.

fields.name: pricing_year
fields.notes: IHACPA pricing year or edition label.

fields.name: input_schema_version
fields.notes: Version of the declared input schema expected by the calculator.

fields.name: output_schema_version
fields.notes: Version of the declared output schema returned by the calculator.

fields.name: parquet_input_path
fields.notes: Parquet-format input path for Spark DataFrame batch consumption.

fields.name: parquet_output_path
fields.notes: Parquet-format output path for Spark DataFrame batch consumption.

fields.name: sql_connection_string
fields.notes: JDBC or DuckDB connection string for SQL-boundary queries.

fields.name: sql_query
fields.notes: SQL query expression referencing pre-computed views.

fields.name: service_url
fields.notes: Configured service endpoint for the fallback transport path.

fields.name: correlation_id
fields.notes: Traceable caller-provided request identifier.

fields.name: metadata
fields.notes: Opaque caller metadata that must not carry calculator logic.

fields.name: fixture_gate
fields.notes: Declared fixture gate for synthetic-only or local-only payload handling.

request_structs.notes: Single versioned Scala/Spark request envelope that mirrors the public calculator contract and adds only transport metadata.

response_structs.name: ScalaSparkBindingResponse

fields.name: schema_version
fields.notes: Binding schema version for the response envelope.

fields.name: calculator_id
fields.notes: Echoes the public calculator identifier.

fields.name: pricing_year
fields.notes: Echoes the pricing year used during execution.

fields.name: mode
fields.notes: Declares the transport path that produced the result.

fields.name: success
fields.notes: True only when the request completed without a blocking error.

fields.name: status
fields.notes: Machine-readable execution state for the caller.

fields.name: message
fields.notes: Short human-readable summary of the result.

fields.name: warnings
fields.notes: Non-blocking warnings attached to the response.

fields.name: errors
fields.notes: Machine-readable error records emitted when the response does not succeed.

fields.name: diagnostics
fields.notes: Structured diagnostic record with pass, fail, and blocked checks.

fields.name: provenance
fields.notes: Provenance record for the request and any generated artifact.

fields.name: service_url
fields.notes: Service endpoint used to complete the request.

fields.name: parquet_output_path
fields.notes: Parquet output path used by the file-exchange boundary.

fields.name: sql_result_path
fields.notes: Path or table reference for SQL query results.

fields.name: fixture_gate_state
fields.notes: Observed fixture-gate outcome for the request.

fields.name: module_readiness_state
fields.notes: Observed Scala/Spark module readiness state for the binding bundle.

response_structs.notes: Single versioned Scala/Spark response envelope that captures success, diagnostics, provenance, and transport-specific outputs.

diagnostics.notes: The Scala/Spark request and response structs mirror the public calculator contract fields.
File-exchange (Parquet/Arrow) and SQL boundary are the primary transport paths.
Service fallback is explicitly declared for online request/response callers.
Fixture gates remain synthetic-only or local-only and do not expose restricted payloads.
Module readiness distinguishes concrete transport-boundary code from release packaging status.

provenance.notes: Name of the contract or validation command that produced the artifact.
Stable identifier for the Scala/Spark binding contract bundle.
Path to the source manifest or fixture record used to derive the example.
Public source URL or local reference used for provenance.
Retrieval date in ISO-8601 date form.
Checksum algorithm used by the bundle.

errors.condition: request or response fields do not match the published Scala/Spark binding schema
errors.notes: Use this when the envelope is structurally invalid.

errors.condition: the fallback service boundary cannot be reached
errors.notes: The caller may retry or switch to a file-exchange boundary.

errors.condition: Parquet/Arrow file handoff cannot be read or written
errors.notes: Use for file-boundary errors in Spark DataFrame batch consumption.

errors.condition: SQL boundary query or connection fails
errors.notes: Use for SQL-boundary errors in Spark SQL or JDBC analytical queries.

errors.condition: synthetic-only or local-only fixture gate is not satisfied
errors.notes: The request must stop before any restricted payload is handled.

errors.condition: the Scala/Spark adapter is unavailable or JVM publication promotion is deferred
errors.notes: Use this when local transport-boundary code is not available, or when a caller asks for public JVM registry evidence that is not claimed.

fixture_gates.notes: Committed examples must stay synthetic and metadata only.
Any licensed payloads stay local-only and user-supplied outside the repository.
The binding must remain pinned to the public calculator contract field set.

module_readiness.notes: The workstream has concrete transport-boundary code but does not assert a published Scala/Spark module or Maven Central release.
The Parquet/Arrow file-exchange boundary is implemented for Spark DataFrame batch consumption.
The SQL boundary is implemented for Spark SQL views and analytical queries.
The service fallback boundary is implemented with the JDK HTTP client and typed request/response envelopes.

rules: Keep all examples synthetic and metadata only.
Mirror the public calculator contract fields explicitly.
Do not duplicate calculator math, thresholds, or adjustment logic in the Scala/Spark binding.
Prefer Parquet/Arrow file exchange or SQL boundary first and use the service boundary for online request/response behavior.
Keep diagnostics, provenance, and errors explicit and machine readable.
Keep fixture gates local-only and user-supplied for any licensed assets.
Treat local Scala/Spark adapter readiness separately from public JVM publication, which remains deferred until registry and CI evidence are available.
